subject: Request for Post-Report Continuity Commitment and Evidence Timeline
messages:
From: security@everwell.com
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
Cc: alice.pieters@auditingfirm.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:15:00 -0400
Subject: Post-report continuity confirmation request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this. We're in the final stages of procurement for a platform agreement with Redwood and our InfoSec review has flagged the audit period gap between the SOC 2 Type II report end date (2028-04-30) and today. Our auditors (AuditingFirm LLP) have asked for a short management statement confirming that there have been no material control changes impacting the SOC scope since 2028-04-30, or alternatively a signed continuity commitment (aka "post-report continuity letter") covering the period from 2028-05-01 to the contract signature target date (2028-08-05).

Specifically, they want to know:
- Whether Redwood can provide a signed continuity commitment that auditors will accept in lieu of an interim SOC report
- A short list of artifacts you can make available (change logs, exception logs, deployment history, access reviews) and an estimated delivery timeline
- Whether the continuity letter should be signed by an independent auditor or if a senior management attestation from Redwood is acceptable to your customers (and if so, who signs)

Our procurement timeline is tight — contract signature is targeted for 2028-08-05. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide either: (A) a management-signed continuity commitment + supporting evidence by 2028-07-26, or (B) an auditor-signed bridge letter by 2028-07-31?

Appreciate a short confirmation and next steps.

Best,
Maya Rao
Security & Compliance, Everwell Therapeutics
[Attachment: SOC2_request_template.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: security@everwell.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com, camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-report continuity confirmation request

On Thu, Jul 12, 2028 at 11:15 AM Maya Rao <security@everwell.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this. We're in the final stages of procurement...

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can support a post-report continuity commitment. A few clarifying points so we can scope the response correctly:  

1) Who will be the acceptance authority on your side — is it AuditingFirm LLP (Alice Pieters) as the independent reviewer, or is your procurement team prepared to accept a Redwood management attestation signed by our Head of Security?
2) For the scope window, you referenced 2028-05-01 -> 2028-08-05. Please confirm whether you need the letter to be backdated to the SOC report end (2028-04-30) or start strictly from 2028-05-01.
3) We can provide a management-signed continuity commitment + a package of supporting artifacts. To meet your 2028-07-26 target we will need sign-off from our external counsel and our auditors to finalize wording (standard language acceptable to many customers). Is delivery by EOD 2028-07-26 a hard deadline?

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in Marcus (infra ops) to gather the deployment/change logs and Camila (audit lead) to prepare the draft language and coordinate with our auditor if an auditor-signed letter is required. I will aim to send a draft by 2028-07-18 for your review and an evidence checklist the same day.

Attaching our latest SOC 2 Type II report to help the reviewers (redacted where applicable).

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2028-04-30.pdf (pdf)]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com, camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Everwell continuity request — artifacts & owners

Marcus / Camila — looping you both in to kick off evidence collection for Everwell. Maya has asked for a management continuity commitment covering 2028-05-01 -> 2028-08-05 (pending confirmation). She also asked for an itemized evidence list and delivery timeline. Please see below and ack:  

Required artifacts (initial):
- Deployment/change logs for production services (2028-05-01 -> present) — Marcus (infra)
- Incident and exception log exports for that window, including RCA summaries for Sev2/3+ incidents — Marcus (ops)
- Access review records and privileged access changes — Camila (SaaS sec)
- Configuration management snapshots and Terraform plans for the relevant clusters — Marcus
- Evidence map linking SOC control IDs to artifacts (we can reuse our existing mapping) — Camila

I attached a simple checklist to help them ingest. Please confirm ETA for bulk exports: ideally we want drafts of the artifact bundle by 2028-07-18 so I can assemble the draft continuity letter and route to counsel. If we need an auditor-signed letter instead, I'll coordinate separately with our auditor — but start with the management package.

Thanks — Hannah
[Attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: security@everwell.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com, camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com, alice.pieters@auditingfirm.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-report continuity confirmation request — draft and timeline

Hi Maya — thanks for your patience. Per our earlier notes, please find attached a draft management continuity commitment covering the period 2028-05-01 through 2028-08-05 plus a proposed evidence bundle and delivery timeline. Highlights:

- Draft continuity commitment (management-signed): attached as continuity_commitment_draft_v1.docx. It is written for acceptance by your procurement and auditors as a management representation. If your auditors require auditor-signed language, please let us know and we'll engage AuditingFirm LLP (Alice) to discuss formal bridge wording.
- Evidence bundle: we will provide the following artifacts by 2028-07-26 (zip package):
  * Production deployment/change log exports (2028-05-01 -> 2028-07-25)
  * Incident and exception logs with RCA summaries for Sev2+ incidents during the window
  * Access review reports and privileged access change list
  * Configuration management snapshots (Terraform state / manifests)
  * SOC control mapping document linking each control to the artifacts
- We do not have any open, unresolved control exceptions that would materially affect SOC scope since 2028-04-30. Any low-impact findings have been remediated; we will include remediation notes in the package.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether AuditingFirm LLP must sign the continuity letter or if a Redwood Director-level signature is acceptable.
2) If acceptable, we'll deliver the management-signed letter and evidence package to you by EOD 2028-07-26.
3) If an auditor-signed bridge letter is required, we'll ask AuditingFirm LLP to draft/endorse — that will likely push the timeline to ~2028-07-31 depending on auditor availability.

Attachments: continuity_commitment_draft_v1.docx, SOC2_TypeII_2028-04-30.pdf, evidence_checklist.xlsx

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
